source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project (IFAD-funded) - "Climate Resilient Banana Growing Technique" (ផលិតកម្មដំណាំចេកដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ), November 2018
text:
White grub (ដង្កូវ) larvae and adult beetles feed on banana roots and the corm, weakening the plant's anchorage and nutrient uptake; keeping the base of the plant clean of decaying plant debris (where adults lay eggs) is the first line of defense, alongside a labeled soil insecticide where infestation is confirmed to be heavy.

A separate weevil bores into the pseudostem and corm tissue, and infested plants may show wilting or structural weakness at the base; sanitation (removing and destroying severely damaged stems) and, where needed, a registered insecticide applied per label are the recommended responses.
